description_en: Queries the SMS sending records and sending status of a single phone number
description_zh: 查询单个号码的短信发送记录和发送状态等信息
name: QuerySendDetails

parameters.help_en:
The phone number to query. Format:

Domestic SMS: An 11-digit phone number, such as 1390000\\.
International/Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan messages: Country code + number, such as 8520000\\.

Only one phone number can be passed in
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的手机号码。格式：

国内短信：11位手机号码，例如1390000\\。
国际/港澳台消息：国际区号+号码，例如8520000\\。

只能传入一个手机号码
parameters.name: phone_number

parameters.help_en:
The sending receipt ID, which is the sending serial number. This is the BizId field returned when you call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419273.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419274.html to send SMS messages.

Only one BizId value can be passed in. Multiple BizId values are not supported
parameters.help_zh:
发送回执ID。即发送流水号，调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419273.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419274.html发送短信时，返回值中的BizId字段。

只能传入一个Bizid的值，无法传入多个Bizid
parameters.name: biz_id

parameters.help_en:
The SMS sending date. Records from the last 30 days can be queried.

Format: yyyyMMdd, such as 20250601
parameters.help_zh:
短信发送日期，支持查询最近30天的记录。

格式：yyyyMMdd，例如20250601
parameters.name: send_date

parameters.help_en:
The number of SMS records displayed per page, used for paginated viewing of sending records.

Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh:
每页显示的短信记录数量，供分页查看发送记录使用。

取值范围为1~50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The current page number of sending records, used for paginated viewing of sending records
parameters.help_zh: 发送记录的当前页码，供分页查看发送记录使用
parameters.name: current_page
